description:
Twelve languages, a BC Grade 12 course library, and a reader for long-form notes — all in one skill tree you work through at your own pace.

Spanish, French, Japanese, Arabic and eight more, practiced the way languages actually stick: short drills, spaced repetition that surfaces a card right before you'd forget it, and speech recognition that makes you say the word out loud instead of tapping the right box.

The course library goes well past languages. Pre-Calculus 12 and Anatomy are built to the BC curriculum. Astrophysics, Anthropology and Physiology cover the ground a first-year science student is expected to already have. Programming, music theory, chess and history are there too, each as a tree you unlock rather than a list you scroll.

The Masterclass reader holds the long-form material — full course notes and book summaries you read straight through, not as flashcards.

Streaks and XP exist to get you back tomorrow, and the whole library works on a plane. Sign in if you want your progress on more than one device; skip it if you don't.
keywords: pre-calculus 12,spaced repetition,speech practice,skill tree,anatomy course,japanese drills
whatsNew: Four new science courses: Astrophysics, Anthropology, Anatomy, and Physiology. Stars and cosmology, human origins and culture, body systems, and how the body works. Checking an answer now gives you a small haptic tap, so you can feel right and wrong without watching the screen.
